title: OpsTruss daemon
description: daemon/<stack>.json: how to reach and stop the daemon of one stack. The daemon lives while it holds daemon/<stack>.lock, so the file outlives it. Readers ignore fields they do not know and refuse a newer version.

start.description: When the process started, as the system tells it; compared only with itself, on this host.

opstruss.description: The version of OpsTruss that the daemon runs.

socket.description: The control socket, in daemon/ or, when that path is too long for a Unix socket, under $TMPDIR.
